scripts.build: pnpm --filter @universal-slots/core clean && pnpm --filter @universal-slots/core build && pnpm --filter @universal-slots/adapter-utils clean && pnpm --filter @universal-slots/adapter-utils build && pnpm --filter @universal-slots/react clean && pnpm --filter @universal-slots/react build && pnpm --filter @universal-slots/preact clean && pnpm --filter @universal-slots/preact build && pnpm typecheck && pnpm --filter universal-slots build
scripts.clean: turbo run clean && rm -rf packages/universal-slots/dist artifacts
scripts.lint: turbo run lint && eslint eslint.config.ts vitest.config.ts scripts
scripts.verify:package:preact-min: pnpm run pack && VERIFY_PREACT_VERSION=11.0.0 node scripts/verify-consumer.mjs
